title: We are Moving
markdown:
Stratum Systems is moving to a new location. Don't worry, it's not far away. We will be operating from the new office as of **May 5, 2014**.


Our new location is more visible from the road and easier to access.


[**#5 2345 Windsor Street, Abbotsford, BC, V2T 6M1**](https://www.google.com/maps/place/5-2345+Windsor+St,+Abbotsford,+BC+V2T+6M1/@49.0448302,-122.3583791,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x5485cab0cf545ca9:0xa6961501284a89c9!8m2!3d49.0448267!4d-122.3558042!16s%2Fg%2F11sszr056s?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI0MTExOC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)
